test_get_loc: test the Index.get_loc method to find the position of a label in a numeric index
test_get_indexer: test the Index.get_indexer method to map target labels to positions in a numeric index
test_get_indexer_methods: test the Index.get_indexer method with pad, backfill, and nearest interpolation strategies
test_get_indexer_tolerance: test the Index.get_indexer method with tolerance and per-element tolerance arrays
test_get_loc_masked_na: test the Index.get_loc method with NA values in masked and Arrow extension arrays
test_take_fill_value: test the Index.take method with fill_value and allow_fill options on numeric indexes
test_slice_locs: test the Index.slice_locs method to compute start and end positions for label-based slices
test_get_slice_bounds: test the Index.get_slice_bound method to compute inclusive or exclusive slice bounds
test_where: test the Index.where method to apply a boolean condition and replace values on a numeric index
test_contains: test the Index __contains__ operator to check membership of values including None and NaN
